text:
Jordan: Heads up — hit a parity bug between the Python SDK embeddings return shape and our rerank helper. Looks like the embedding endpoint and the reranker disagree on the key name/shape.

Sam: Ugh. Can you paste a minimal example of what you see?

Jordan: Sure. From a quick repro (sync client) — note the response keys:
```py
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-lite-1", input="text")
print(resp)
# {'object': 'list', 'data': [{'object': 'embedding', 'embedding': [0.0123, 0.456, ...], 'index': 0}], 'model': 'embed-lite-1'}
```
But the rerank helper expects items like `{'values': [...], 'id': ...}`. So when I feed the embeddings response directly into `rerank.rerank_items(...)` it blows up with KeyError: 'values'.

Maria: That matches what I saw a few days ago — we have legacy code paths where embeddings used `values` (old internal proto) and newer API uses `embedding`. The SDK tried to be thin and surface raw API objects which caused the mismatch.

Eve: Two UX things here: 1) typing — our dataclass/TypedDicts use `embedding: List[float]`, but rerank typing expects `values: Sequence[float]`. 2) async batching behaviour — when people use the async batch helper we split long requests into chunks. If the server 429s on one chunk, the retry logic doesn't map back to the per-item shape, so adapters never run and users see shape errors instead of retry errors.

Sam: Proposed fixes: add a small normalization adapter in `EmbeddingsClient` that returns a uniform shape for downstream helpers. We can accept both shapes as input in rerank: `values` or `embedding`. Also add `normalize=True` flag to `client.embeddings.batch(...)` which yields items in canonical form. Thoughts?

Jordan: I like normalize flag. Minimal change would be helper fn `normalize_embedding_item(item)` that does: `if 'embedding' in item: item['values'] = item.pop('embedding')` so older helpers keep working.

Maria: Also we should update type hints to a single canonical name (prefer `embedding`) and then include a tiny adapter when passing into older helpers. Update docs/snippets to show canonical pipeline: `resp = client.embeddings.create(...); items = normalize(resp.data); rerank.rerank(items)`

Eve: For the async case let's add unit tests that simulate partial 429 and ensure adapter runs after chunk retries. Filing a small RFC in the SDK repo for the approach.

Sam: I can spin up a quick PR: - add `sdk.normalize_embedding_item` + tests - update rerank to accept either key - add batch normalize flag - add typing alias `EmbeddingVector = List[float]` into `types.py`

Jordan: Awesome. Also note: if we accept both shapes we should make telemetry event `sdk.embedding_shape_mismatch` so we can see how many users still send legacy `values`.

ci-bot: Created ticket ML-SDK-2147 and linked PR draft: https://git.internal.redwood/rdw/sdk/pull/789 (draft).

Maria: :thumbsup: one more ask — add a note in the migration doc for Python users who relied on `item['values']` to avoid surprise breakages.

Sam: Will do. I'll post the PR link here once tests pass.

Eve: Thanks all. Small checklist: update adapter, typings, batch tests (async+sync), docs, telemetry.

Jordan: Thanks — marking this resolved for now, will re-open if new edge cases crop up. :white_check_mark:
